name: ES Sunlogy Berhad
overview: 2026年，ES Sunlogy 通过子公司 Sunlogy Asia Energy Storage 获得位于吉隆坡 Menara Vista Petaling 的电池储能系统（BESS）供应、安装、测试及调试订单，价值 RM5,260,619；同时通过全资子公司 Savelite Engineering 获得槟城 Pulau Andaman 两项分包工程，分别为基础设施工程（RM5,197,486）和电气及超低压（ELV）工程。此外，公司提出新的经常性关联交易股东授权，涉及与 Kerjaya 集团的交易。
overview_en: In 2026, ES Sunlogy, through its subsidiary Sunlogy Asia Energy Storage, secured a purchase order for the supply, installation, testing and commissioning of a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) at Menara Vista Petaling, Kuala Lumpur, valued at RM5,260,619. Its wholly-owned subsidiary Savelite Engineering also secured two sub-contract works in Pulau Andaman, Penang, for infrastructure works (RM5,197,486) and electrical and extra low voltage (ELV) works.

segments.name: 机械与电气工程服务
segments.note: 今年获得槟城 Pulau Andaman 的基础设施分包工程及电气与 ELV 工程分包合约。
segments.note_en: Secured sub-contract works for infrastructure and electrical & ELV works at Pulau Andaman, Penang this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Savelite Engineering 接受 Kerjaya Prospek (M) Sdn. Bhd. 的授标书，担任槟城 Pulau Andaman 基础设施工程的分包商，合约金额 RM5,197,486。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Savelite Engineering accepted a Letter of Acceptance from Kerjaya Prospek (M) Sdn. Bhd. as domestic sub-contractor for infrastructure works at Pulau Andaman, Penang, for a sub-contract sum of RM5,197,486.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Savelite Engineering 接受 Kerjaya Prospek (M) Sdn. Bhd. 的授标书，负责槟城 Pulau Andaman Lot 854 的电气及超低压（ELV）工程供应、交付、安装、测试及调试。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Savelite Engineering accepted a Letter of Acceptance from Kerjaya Prospek (M) Sdn. Bhd. for the supply, delivery, installation, testing and commissioning of electrical and Extra Low Voltage (ELV) works at Lot 854, Pulau Andaman, Penang.

segments.name: 可再生能源销售
segments.note: 今年通过 70% 持股子公司 Sunlogy Asia Energy Storage 获得电池储能系统（BESS）订单。
segments.note_en: Secured a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) order through 70%-owned subsidiary Sunlogy Asia Energy Storage this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 70% 持股子公司 Sunlogy Asia Energy Storage 接受 Kerjaya Property Sdn. Bhd. 的采购订单，在吉隆坡 Menara Vista Petaling 供应、安装、测试及调试 34 台电池储能系统（BESS），订单价值 RM5,260,619。
actions.text_en: 70%-owned subsidiary Sunlogy Asia Energy Storage accepted a purchase order from Kerjaya Property Sdn. Bhd.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 今年提议新的经常性关联交易股东授权，涉及与 Kerjaya 集团的交易。
segments.note_en: Proposed a new shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions involving the Kerjaya Group this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 涉及与 Kerjaya 集团的交易。
actions.text_en: Proposed to seek shareholders' approval at an EGM for a new shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions (RRPTs) involving the Kerjaya Group.
